track_analyses.senior_expectations: Architecture ownership, failure analysis, security and defensible trade-offs; see individual posting scope rather than treating title/years alone as seniority.
track_analyses.emerging_evidence_status: Contemporary observed requirements, not statistically demonstrated growth.
track_analyses.niche_interpretation: Single occurrence in this small sample does not establish market niche status; domain-specific SDK/payment/media expertise separately noted in posting summaries.
track_analyses.decline_status: Not measurable from a one-day cross-sectional sample. Jenkins and established CI tools remain relevant where requested; no invented decline trend.
track_analyses.limitations: Purposive sample, not representative. Cloud category has only one posting; senior category includes one expired Kenyan stretch architecture role. Categories are disjoint; alternatives count as mentions, not mandatory mastery of every option.

methodology.posting_date_range: Most publication dates unavailable; one observed posting is October 26, 2026. Live descriptions are contemporary observations, not verified recently posted vacancies.
methodology.sampling: Purposive public-source discovery across six role categories; 11 employer-hosted ATS descriptions and one Kenyan secondary-board expired description.
methodology.coding: Manual required/preferred coding; aliases normalized to capabilities; each skill counted once per posting; required alternatives retained as mentions; preferred-only is mention minus required.
methodology.denominator_policy: Overall denominator is all 12 postings; track denominator is disjoint primary categories. Skill absence means not observed, not not-valued.
methodology.geographic_limits: Only one Kenyan posting, no representative development-organization sample and several country-restricted remote roles.
methodology.trend_limits: No salary, hiring-volume, growth, decline or role-demand ranking statistics inferred.
methodology.refresh_policy: Re-check candidate vacancy on application day; refresh sampled roles within 14 days and version snapshots rather than silently replacing history.
